title: Caring as a way in
header_line: My analysis of one book on negotiation. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: How do you reach a person who is hard to reach?
I described two ways to reach a decision maker through a gatekeeper: give your reasons, and the second way, caring. I said that a secretary in the end gave me the direct number.
I asked: what else could I have added to that mix to add more strength?
I said that some people speak in a way that is distant and cold instead of soothing, and that they do not have empathy; they are very analytical.
I said that introverted people are more like mathematicians and scientists, who spend time researching. This is a general view of mine, to be verified.
A student said that going into a little more detail would help him comprehend, and that with his own business he has several things to go to but none for this.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write how you would show you care.
Write how you will match it.

check.q: What two ways did I describe?
What did I say cold speakers lack?
What kind of view is the claim about introverts?

recap: Give reasons and show you care. Match their style.
